thesis: Selected money lessons emphasize pace, liquidity, and deliberate expectations.
summary: This long source contains more lessons than this selected review covers. The checked passages warn about rushing wealth creation and discuss emergency savings, unexpected expenses, and expectations. Money is framed as serving a broader life rather than an endless scoreboard. No portfolio outcome or savings target is independently validated.
